about: Ark models to make again (lane ARK-MODELS). Written by lane ARK-POSE (coordinator, batch 14d). Each row: the model's slug, why, what was seen and how to see it again, and what the scene holds back for it meanwhile ("sit": its posed sit, POSED_SIT_HELD in src/ark-scene/rig-player.ts; null: nothing). Nothing here is a species fact: every row is read off the model's rest pose in its live rig file (ark-rig/v3), drawn from its front and its side by scripts/ark-pose-heads.mts.

models.reason: The model's head is turned at rest.
models.seen: From the front its head is in profile, facing its own right, a little up. With the neck bone turned through a strip of yaws the face is square to the front at 80 to 90 degrees to its left, so the turn is about 85 degrees. Its face moves with the neck bone and its head bone holds the crown alone: a head turn moves the crown without the face.
